reference: User Game Report render attached in this conversation; design/layout authority only, sample figures are not factual authority.
beforeAfterScope: Approved reference compared with original final native screenshots; no claim that the screenshot itself is the design authority.

observations.panelOrder: Brand/back, breadcrumb, Game Report hero+quarter table, Overview/Box Score/Drives/Plays, Game Snapshot, Team Comparison, Player Performances, Scoring by Quarter, Availability/Participation and Sources, bottom navigation and source footer align with the reference.
observations.framing: Both phone widths retain robust angled sapphire/gold metal panel borders and bright cyan outlines; desktop preserves the same centered mobile frame without horizontal stretching.
observations.typography: Strong condensed section/control typography, bright white/ice-blue values, legible statistical columns; no visible overlapping labels or clipped relevant controls in reviewed frames.
observations.helmets: High-resolution silver Dallas and navy/red Houston decorative helmets face inward toward the actual score; team marks remain sharp, with correct proportions and no stretched raster screenshot interface.
observations.gemControls: Faceted diamond icons and glints are present in headings and full-box/play-by-play controls, with bright blue beveled CTA outlines. No visible pixelation in reviewed original assets at the intended rendering scale.
observations.nativeFocus: View Sources displays a white native focus outline after the audited source dialog was closed. This is an actual keyboard-focus state, not part of the baseline render or a pixel artifact; no evidence alteration or focus suppression is justified.
observations.statistics: Genuine selected game shows Dallas34-Houston30, quartersDAL3/3/14/14,HOU10/6/7/7,totaloffence399/397,netpassing324/335,rushing75/62. SnapshotDALQ414-7,rush+13,HOU netpass+11 correctly follows audited source arithmetic rather than the reference sample.
observations.bottom: Actual DakPrescott profile/controls, cumulative scoring3/6/20/34 and10/16/23/30, availability/source controls and five navigation icons remain framed and readable at both phones.

qualification: This is a qualitative comparison of a native functional interpretation; hero spacing, decorative gem faceting and exact reference pixels differ, so pixel-identical or flawless replication is not asserted.
Actual source-backed values and unavailable/disputed declarations replace fictional sample totals/placeholders and Design Preview copy.
Natural motion phase differs between static snapshots; the reviewer did not seek, pause or alter any clocks. Actual normal/reduced/restored motion remains the browser owner’s separate native test.
Reviewed originals are partial top/bottom viewports, not a stitched full-page substitute. White frame edges at the viewport boundary are normal scroll framing.
The hero displays the retained primary-provider venue label; provider naming variants are a source-policy matter with alternatives in Sources, not established by visual inspection.
